author: dalluyonstudio
title: Looking for Graphic Artist and Video Editor
content:
WE ARE LOOKING FOR GRAPHIC ARTIST AND VIDEO EDITOR!

Job Title: Graphic Artist (Freelance)

The Role: You will work closely with our social media manager. We are not only looking for someone with a sharp eye for design but also someone meticulous with text placement (such as CTA) and image compositions that convert viewers into followers, players, wishlisters, etc. Moreover, we need someone who is proactive with design suggestions and reflects brand elements surrounding Philippine culture & tradition incorporated into our games.

Key Responsibilities:

- Create game content poster layouts and graphic images for social media use.
Use digital illustration, photo editing software, and layout software to create designs.
- Collaborate with the social media team and production team to develop creative solutions.
- Follow brand guidelines, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and revision feedback efficiently.

Job Title: Video Editor (Freelance)

The Role: You will work closely with our social media manager. We are not only looking for a visual, creative video editor but someone who knows how to hook doomscrollers on social media. Someone who knows how to arrange effective hooks, sound effects, and video transitions. And capable of crafting both short-form reels and long-form videos.

Key Responsibilities:
- Ability to create short-form reels and understand different types of hooks: text, visual, and transition hooks that grab people's attention in 3 seconds.
- Edit a combination of raw video, photos, and audio into long-form formats. Add strong opening hooks, dynamic captions, sound effects (SFX), background music, and motion graphics.
- Perform basic color grading, audio cleanup, and visual formatting for different platforms.
- Follow brand guidelines, SOPs, and revision feedback efficiently.
- Meet daily/weekly production and turnaround targets.

Check our Facebook post: https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1ECvYzTQPm/
